name: MCPJungle
tagline: Self-hosted MPL-2.0 MCP gateway: register servers once and point Claude, Cursor, Codex or your own agents at a single endpoint with unified discovery and optional tool groups

xSignals.text: Stop configuring every MCP server in every AI client. MCPJungle is a self-hosted MCP gateway for developers and teams managing multiple MCP servers. It helps you cut duplicated setup by registering servers once and connecting Claude, Cursor, Codex, or your own agents to a single endpoint.
